manifest.leakage_note: every input match starts before 2026-08-20T00:00:00Z, asserted in the fetcher on both the league listing and each match payload

estimator.chain: player-game -> role arithmetic mean -> top two games in a series -> best series in the period -> equal-weight mean over event blocks -> expectation over the Main Event series-count distribution
estimator.expected_maximum: closed form over the empirical series pool, not simulated
estimator.uncertainty: hierarchical bootstrap: resample event blocks, then series within
estimator.coach_stacking: additive (prefix + suffix); multiplicative reported as sensitivity

consumed_read_only: the saved league feed topology via ti_predict.bracket

mid.semantics_note: Which slots are raised, which is lowered, and the tier step size are all unstated. Enumerated as an unweighted outcome set, never as an expectation.
Mid layout is red/blue/green/red/green, so the first green emblem is slot 3.

No positional qualifier. The repository precedent (state 7, DOTA_FantasyCraft_Operation_Target_Ruby = 'Red Emblems') reads a bare colour as the ALL-of-colour target, as distinct from the first/last/random variants which this same board also carries. That reading is recorded but NOT asserted: both the all-of-colour and the single-unknown-slot readings are evaluated.

core.semantics_note: Bare colour, no positional qualifier; same ambiguity as OP3 and evaluated both ways.
The client states the target is random. Which of the three reds is hit is genuinely stochastic; the tier outcome distribution is separately unknown.
Core layout is red/green/red/green/red, so the last green emblem is slot 4.
